# Dubai Express Visas (Dubai Visa Assistance)

> Commercial UAE & Dubai visa assistance service helping tourists, business visitors, transit passengers, and GCC residents prepare, verify, and submit online UAE e-Visa applications (14-day, 30-day, 60-day, Multiple Entry, 48/96h Transit, 5-Year Multi-Entry, GCC Resident Entry Permit, and In-Country Extensions).

**Important Regulatory Disclosure**: Dubai Express Visas (dubaiexpressvisas.com) is a private commercial visa consultancy and travel assistance provider. It is NOT an official UAE government portal, GDRFA, ICP, or embassy. Applicants may also apply directly via official UAE government portals (`gdrfad.gov.ae` / `icp.gov.ae`). Final visa approval and processing decisions rest solely with UAE immigration authorities.

- **Website**: https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/
- **Helpline / WhatsApp**: +91 95654 16467
- **Express Fast-Track Turnaround**: 4 to 12 hours (eligible short-term categories)
- **Regular Turnaround**: 24 to 72 business hours
- **Full AI Knowledge Base**: https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/llms-full.txt

## Core UAE & Dubai Visa Services
- [Dubai 14 Days Express Visa](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-14-days-visa): Single or multiple entry 14-day stay permit with 4–12h express option for urgent business or short trips.
- [Dubai 30 Days Tourist Visa](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-30-days-visa): Most popular 30-day single-entry e-Visa (60-day entry validity, extendable inside UAE).
- [Dubai 60 Days Tourist Visa](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-60-days-visa): Extended 60-day single-entry stay for family visits, remote stays, and long holidays.
- [Dubai Multiple Entry Visa](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-multiple-entry-visa): 30-day and 60-day multi-entry permits for cruise passengers and GCC side-trips.
- [Dubai 48 & 96 Hours Transit Visa](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-transit-visa): Non-extendable airport stopover permits for layovers at DXB and DWC with confirmed onward tickets.
- [UAE 5-Year Multiple Entry Visa](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/uae-5-year-visa): Self-sponsored 5-year tourist visa allowing up to 90 days stay per visit (requires USD 4,000 6-month bank balance + UAE health insurance).
- [GCC Resident UAE Visa](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/gcc-resident-visa): 30-day entry permit for expatriate residents of Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait, and Bahrain with 3+ months GCC residency validity.
- [Dubai Visa Extension](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-visa-extension): In-country 30-day or 60-day tourist visa renewal without exiting the UAE.

## Requirements, Tracking & Guides
- [Dubai Visa Requirements & Checklist](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/visa-requirements): Mandatory passport (6+ months validity), white-background photo, minor NOC, and GCC rules.
- [Track Dubai Visa Status](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/track): Check application progress via Reference Number or Passport Number.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/faq): Answers on processing times, children's visas, overstay fines, and extensions.
- [Dubai Visa for Indians](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-visa-for-indians): Complete guide for Indian passport holders including VOA eligibility for US/UK/EU visa holders.
- [Dubai Visa on Arrival for Indians](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-visa-on-arrival-indians): 14-day & 60-day VOA rules vs pre-arranged e-Visa comparison.
- [Dubai Visa Requirements Guide](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-visa-requirements): Passport MRZ scanning and biometric photo compliance guide.
- [Dubai Visa Processing Time](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-visa-processing-time): Realistic UAE working-day timelines and delay factors.
- [Dubai Visa Documents Checklist](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-visa-documents): Complete document preparation matrix by traveler category.
- [Dubai Visa Rejection Reasons](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-visa-rejection-reasons): Common causes of UAE visa refusal and how to prevent or reapply.
- [Dubai Overstay Fine Rules & Extensions](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-overstay-fine-rules): Daily UAE overstay fine structure, grace periods, and legal regularization.
- [Dubai Visa Fees & Cost Guide](https://www.dubaiexpressvisas.com/dubai-visa-fees): Fee components (government vs service fees) and processing tier breakdown.
